bydomingo

The first bird

A small test poem.

This morning

the bird sang

as if there were

already someone

listening.

Four Notes About Doorbells

A doorbell is a tiny public performance made for one unwilling listener.

A finger arrives before the visitor.

The room becomes quiet to hear it.

Behind the wall, someone decides whether to exist.

The CEO Machine

A small wooden machine announces its occupation and leaves the scene.

Two figures walk through the screen. The taller one says, “I’m a CEO.” The sentence plays through a small speaker, and both figures continue out of view.

The machine has no other business function.

Kitchen Motor, Slowed Down

A domestic motor recorded after midnight and reduced until it resembles weather.

Recorded in one take. No motor was harmed or improved.
